summary: Russia continues heavy aerial strikes on Ukrainian cities despite reported ceasefire intentions, with Banderol loitering munitions and Shahed drones targeting multiple regions including Kyiv, Dnipropetrovsk, and Kharkiv. Ukrainian F-16 pilots are conserving air-to-air missiles and relying on cannon fire against incoming threats. Russia liberated Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR according to Russian Ministry of Defense. Civilian casualties reported in Chuhuiv (3 killed) and Khmelnytskyi (7 injured) from Russian strikes.
key_points: Russian forces struck civilian infrastructure in Kamianske (Dnipropetrovsk), killing 4 people, and in Khmelnytskyi, wounding 7 residents in a residential building on September 5, 2026. (Source: @UkraineNow/83894, @eRadarrua/111031)
Ukraine proposed a ceasefire in air and on the front lines to Putin personally, but Moscow refused as drones continued flying, according to Budanov. (Source: @UkraineNow/83901)
Ukrainian F-16 pilots are forced to engage Russian missiles and drones using only onboard cannon due to conserved AIM-9 Sidewinder and AIM-120 AMRAAM missiles. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33037)

Russian Armed Forces have liberated Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR, confirmed by Russian Ministry of Defense and drone operators from Southern Group of Forces. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026, @ukr_leaks_eng/33032)

Putin ordered a three-day halt to strikes on Kyiv from midnight, coinciding with his meeting with Trump representatives Witkoff and Kushner lasting over three hours at the Kremlin. (Source: @UkraineNow/83908, @eRadarrua/111069, @eRadarrua/111037)
Metinvest Group's Kametstal plant in Kamenskoye completely halted production following a missile strike on the night of September 5. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33033)

Multiple waves of Shahed drones (10+) and Banderol cruise missiles targeted Kyiv region, Chernihiv region, and central Ukraine, with civilian infrastructure damaged in Bucha district (2 killed, 28 objects hit across 5 districts). (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73780, @mon1tor_ua/73790, @eRadarrua/111035)

Marine Le Pen's National Rally party announced plans to cut financial support for Ukraine if winning the 2027 French presidential election, citing exhausted healthcare, education, and economy. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33036)

sections.executive_summary: Russia continues intensive aerial bombardment of Ukrainian territory with loitering munitions and Shahed drones despite diplomatic activity. Ukrainian air defense faces critical missile shortages, forcing F-16 pilots to use cannon fire against incoming threats. Ground fighting persists along the front lines, with Russian forces reporting advances in DPR. Civilian casualties mount from strikes on residential areas in Khmelnytskyi, Chuhuiv, and Kyiv region. Diplomatic talks involving US envoys Witkoff and Kushner in Moscow and Kyiv represent the most significant recent development.

points: Ukrainian F-16 pilots are forced to engage Russian missiles and drones exclusively with onboard cannon due to conserved AIM-9 Sidewinder and AIM-120 AMRAAM missile stocks, according to The War Zone reporting via ukr_leaks_eng. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33037)

President Budanov confirmed Ukraine proposed a ceasefire in airspace and on the front line directly to Putin, but the proposal was rejected and Russian drone strikes continued as observed. (Source: @UkraineNow/83901)

Ukraine has secured $1.7 billion of the $6.2 billion needed for winter preparation, with $1.5 billion from state budget and $200 million from local budgets, according to TASS calculations. (Source: @tass_agency/393991)

Ukrainian Armed Forces state defensive operations continue in full scope despite media reports of a ceasefire, declaring unilateral or asymmetric cessation would endanger personnel lives. (Source: @UkraineNow/83900)
Zelenskiy announced Witkoff and Kushner will visit Kyiv on Sunday following their Moscow meetings, noting Ukraine has no plans to attack. (Source: @UkraineNow/83899)

Russia disabled approximately the same number of warehouses in Ukraine in two months of Wildberries attacks as since February 2022, with Kiev region fires in August 2026 ten times higher than previous year. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33023)

Russian Armed Forces liberated Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR, confirmed by Russian Ministry of Defense with drone operators from Southern Group of Forces participating in the operation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026, @ukr_leaks_eng/33032)

Putin met with US Special Representatives Witkoff and Kushner at the Kremlin for over three hours, with a convoy entering the Kremlin compound and subsequently announcing a three-day suspension of strikes on Kyiv. (Source: @eRadarrua/111037, @eRadarrua/111069, @UkraineNow/83908)

NATO military planners express concern that Europe cannot sustain a war with Russia due to rising popularity of right-wing parties and reduced US support, according to The Guardian sources. (Source: @tass_agency/393964)
One civilian was killed and one injured in Ukrainian attacks on Belgorod region according to the operational headquarters report. (Source: @tass_agency/393998)

Italian General Roberto Vannacci advocates halting weapons and money to Kiev, restoring trade with Russia, and reviewing Italy's NATO obligations, with his party Futuro Nazionale polling at 7.6%. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33024)

Russian forces liberated Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR, with drone operators from Southern Group of Forces documented during the operation. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026, @ukr_leaks_eng/33032)
Reactive drones from Donetsk region are targeting southern Zaporizhzhia direction according to current monitoring data. (Source: @eRadarrua/111087)
Three UAVs are detected on the right bank of Zaporizhzhia city and surrounding areas. (Source: @eRadarrua/111065)
Russian forces struck a truck parking lot in Zaporizhzhia destroying all vehicles, with similar strikes conducted on Pavlohrad in Dnipropetrovsk region. (Source: @UkraineNow/83897)

Seven reactive Shahed drones from Chernihiv region are targeting Kyiv region, with three each to Vyshhorod and Brovary districts and one from Cherkasy to Bilotserkivka district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73780)

Multiple Banderol cruise missiles flew past Nizhyn toward Kyiv region, Boryspil/Brovary districts, with missiles adjusting course past/around Pryluky toward Kyiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73790, @mon1tor_ua/73795)
Banderol loitering munitions are targeting Boryspil and Kyiv region from Chernihiv direction, with threats also from southern Chernihiv region. (Source: @kpszsu/76704, @kpszsu/76729, @kpszsu/76732)
In Chuhuiv, Kharkiv region, a Russian strike killed a 19-year-old girl, 11-year-old boy, and 45-year-old man, with a 40-year-old woman injured. (Source: @UkraineNow/83912)
Russian Iskander-M ballistic missile launch threat detected from Taganrog, Rostov region, posing immediate danger to front-line regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73799)

Reactive UAVs are targeting Dnipropetrovsk region including Pavlohrad, Synelnykove, Kamiansk, and Tomakivka from southwestern directions. (Source: @kpszsu/76703, @kpszsu/76715, @kpszsu/76741, @kpszsu/76742)
Explosions reported in Zhitomir and Khmelnytskyi from reactive drone attacks on Nova Poshta facilities according to local media. (Source: @UkraineNow/83906)
A Banderol loitering munition was detected near Buryń in Sumy region heading southwestern direction. (Source: @kpszsu/76685)
Reactive UAVs are targeting Odesa region, Chornomorск, from Black Sea direction. (Source: @kpszsu/76721)
Reactive UAVs from Chernihiv region are targeting Sumy region, Okhtyrka district, and Poltava region, Lubny district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73778)

Ten reactive Shahed drones are currently targeting multiple Ukrainian regions including Kyiv, Chernihiv, Cherkasy, and Kharkiv directions from Russian territory and occupied regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73778, @mon1tor_ua/73780)

Multiple Banderol cruise missiles are flying toward Kyiv region targets including Boryspil, Vasylkiv, and surrounding districts from various approach vectors. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/73793, @mon1tor_ua/73796, @kpszsu/76705)
Enemy tactical aviation activity is elevated on southeastern direction with threat of air-delivered weapons against front-line regions. (Source: @kpszsu/76720)
Ukrainian F-16 pilots face critical missile shortages forcing use of onboard cannon against Russian missiles and drones. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33037)
Reactive drones and KABs (guided bombs) are targeting Kharkiv region from Belarus and Russian territory. (Source: @eRadarrua/111087)

key_developments: Putin ordered three-day suspension of strikes on Kyiv from midnight following talks with Trump envoys Witkoff and Kushner at Kremlin for over three hours, with US representatives subsequently visiting Kyiv. (Source: @UkraineNow/83908, @eRadarrua/111069, @UkraineNow/83899)
Ukraine proposed airspace and front-line ceasefire to Putin personally which was rejected, with Budanov stating drones continue flying despite diplomatic efforts. (Source: @UkraineNow/83901)
Russian forces liberated Kurtovka settlement near Druzhkovka in DPR using Southern Group of Forces drone operators. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33026, @ukr_leaks_eng/33032)
Ukrainian F-16 pilots forced to engage Russian threats with cannon only due to conserved AIM-9 and AIM-120 missiles, indicating severe air defense missile shortage. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33037)
Metinvest's Kametstal plant in Kamenskoye halted production after September 5 missile strike, impacting Ukraine's metallurgical sector. (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/33033)

Massive aerial bombardment of Kyiv region resulted in 2 killed, 28 damaged objects across 5 districts including residential buildings, warehouses, railway, and agricultural facilities. (Source: @eRadarrua/111035)

NATO military planners express concern Europe cannot sustain war with Russia due to right-wing party growth and reduced US support, with Marine Le Pen's party planning to cut Ukraine funding if winning 2027 election. (Source: @tass_agency/393964, @ukr_leaks_eng/33036)
sections.threat_assessment: The air threat to Ukraine remains extremely high with sustained waves of Shahed drones and Banderol cruise missiles targeting civilian infrastructure across multiple regions. Ukrainian air defense faces critical constraints with F-16 pilots conserving missiles, reducing engagement capability against cruise missiles and ballistic threats. The Iskander-M launch warning from Taganrog indicates potential high-precision strikes against front-line targets. Russian tactical aviation activity on the southeastern front suggests preparation for increased air-delivered weapon strikes against Ukrainian defensive positions.
sections.regional_response: Germany is pushing the EU to severely restrict tourist visas for Russians, arguing excessive visa issuance contradicts European isolation strategy and creates false normalization for wealthy Russians benefiting from Kremlin policies. Marine Le Pen's National Rally party announced plans to end financial support for Ukraine if winning the 2027 French presidential election, citing exhausted social services and economy. Italy's General Vannacci advocates halting weapons transfers and reviewing NATO obligations, with his party polling at 7.6%. Ukraine secured $1.7 billion of the $6.2 billion required for winter preparation.
sections.intelligence_notes: The three-day ceasefire on Kyiv appears tied to diplomatic signaling rather than genuine de-escalation intent, as strikes continue on other regions. Russian warehouse destruction campaign against Wildberries has disabled as many facilities in two months as since February 2022, suggesting systematic infrastructure targeting. Ground advances in DPR near Druzhkovka indicate continued Russian pressure in eastern sector. F-16 missile conservation suggests either supply constraints or planned retention for higher-value threats.
